name: pimbay/search-query
description: Framework-agnostic, strict search/pagination contracts (page, slice, cursor) with no runtime magic — a foundation for datasource-specific extensions (Doctrine, Eloquent, Elasticsearch, ...).

scripts.test:coverage: docker compose run --rm php83 sh -c 'composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress && XDEBUG_MODE=coverage php vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text --coverage-clover=var/tests/coverage.xml -d --min-coverage=100'
scripts.test:mutation: docker compose run --rm php83 sh -c 'composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress && XDEBUG_MODE=coverage vendor/bin/infection --threads=max --min-msi=100 --min-covered-msi=100'
scripts.test:83: docker compose run --rm php83 sh -c 'composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress && php vendor/bin/phpunit --no-coverage'
scripts.test:84: docker compose run --rm php84 sh -c 'composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress && php vendor/bin/phpunit --no-coverage'
scripts.test:85: docker compose run --rm php85 sh -c 'composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress && php vendor/bin/phpunit --no-coverage'
